newsitem.title: INDIA: World market sentiment boosts Indian gold.
newsitem.headline: World market sentiment boosts Indian gold.

text.p: Indian 24 carat gold prices on Friday opened 25 rupees up at 4,530 rupees per 10 grammes on thin supplies and favourable world market sentiment, dealers said.
Gold was up by 55 rupees per 10 grammes on Thursday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.64 grammes) opened 300 rupees up at 53,000 rupees, against a rise of 700 rupees on Thursday.
"Premiums of special licences to import gold remained quiet at 12.80/12.90 percent in the early trade," one broker said.
Silver (.999) opened 40 rupees higher at 6,255 rupees per kg against the previous close of 6,215 rupees as a rally in the world market prompted speculative buying in early trade.
Silver was down by 60 rupees per kg on Thursday.
Industrial buying for silver slowed down in early deals.
